figma.frameName: Harmony Gates / Progression Run / FINAL / DEMO 01

backgroundLayer.name: progression 1
backgroundLayer.rule: Clean static background only. It must not contain baked chord orbs, pedestal rings, chord labels, Roman numerals, or progression-path graphics.

figma.prototypePurpose: Demonstrate the motion language of the independent progression track. The four Figma frames are animation snapshots only, not a four-chord exercise limit and not production state architecture.

prototypeStates.name: Harmony Gates / Progression Run / FINAL / DEMO 01

transition.note: Compose may be micro-tuned during implementation, but the Figma motion and pacing are the visual reference.

productionRules: Never bake the progression path or chord orbs into the background asset.
Use one parameterized Compose track renderer for every progression.
Orbs are generic reusable containers. Chord text and harmonic-function text are runtime data.
Progression length is arbitrary and must not be constrained by the number of Figma demo frames or visible orb slots.
The room/environment remains visually static while the track advances.
Do not implement four separate production screens corresponding to the four Figma demo frames.

trackRenderer.visibleWindowRule: Eight slots are the current landscape visual target. The progression itself may contain any number of events. Off-screen events are represented by runtime data, not additional permanently mounted screen objects.
trackRenderer.recyclingRule: When activeChordIndex advances, each visible orb moves one perspective slot toward the player. The orb leaving the near end is recycled for the next event entering at the far end.

orbStates.upcoming: normal dark orb with readable cream/gold labels
orbStates.incorrect_or_incomplete: feedback may be shown, but the track must not advance

orbContent.secondary: ChordEvent.functionLabel when enabled by assistance mode
orbContent.optional: inversion, voicing, guide-tone, or assistance hint supplied by runtime state

advanceAnimation.behavior: All visible orbs slide smoothly to the next fixed perspective slot. Active emphasis transfers to the new current chord. A new upcoming chord enters at the far end. The background does not move.
advanceAnimation.interruptPolicy: Do not start a second advance while an advance animation is running. Queue at most one valid advance event.

requirements: Evaluate the ChordEvent at activeChordIndex, not rendered label text.
Wrong or incomplete chords never advance.
Do not advance twice from a held chord or sustain state.
Require a new qualifying note-state after each accepted advance.
Respect root, bass, inversion, omission and voicing-family policies from ChordEvent.
Figma clicks only simulate advancement. Production advancement comes from MIDI recognition or an explicit manual Next action.

endBehavior.loopFalse: After the final event is completed, finish the run and show results.
endBehavior.loopTrue: Recycle the first event into the far-upcoming position and continue seamlessly.

interactionMapStatus: Track motion semantics are current. Non-track control hit regions must be mapped from the approved 77:2 frame before production wiring; do not reuse coordinates from the deleted 49:* prototype frames.
